description: This file contains the implementation of a GStreamer plugin for Rialto, specifically registering custom sink elements for video, audio, and web audio communication with RialtoServer. It includes plugin initialization logic, environment variable handling, and plugin registration functions.

methods.name: rialto_mse_sinks_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers the Rialto GStreamer sink plugins based on environment variables and plugin parameters.
